logs.description: Asked him about the handling image uploads, and how to to serve them.
logs.reflection: For recipe image uploads I went with multer saving files straight into an uploads/ folder in the backend. Uploading works fine, but actually serving the images back is more of a hassle than I expected, especially thinking about production. The folder sits inside the app directory, so the image data ends up tied to the app's lifecycle in a container, a redeploy would just wipe everything while the database still points to those paths. And every image request has to go through the api, which isn't great.
